edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from the dispute that is the subject of this Agreement (the “Dispute”). This draft is for discussion only; all terms remain subject to both clients’ approval and execution of a definitive agreement.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [proposed amount subject to client confirmation] (the “Settlement Amount”) in cleared funds within [payment period subject to client confirmation] days after the date on which the last party signs this Agreement (the “Effective Date”).

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising from the Dispute. This release does not extend to unrelated claims or to rights to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them as required by law or to its legal and tax advisers. A party disclosing terms to its advisers shall inform them of their confidential nature.
